Resin-cast sculpture · 2024

A Typical NAND

A small-scale resin sculpture developed through 3D modeling, mold-making, and casting, bringing digital and physical materials into the same object.

Medium
3D modeling, plywood, resin, silicone rubber, USB drive, pigments
Dimensions
8 × 3 × 5 in
Year
2024

Collection of Peggy Phelps & East Galleries, Claremont, CA.
